findings.title: SQL Injection via Allowlist Bypass - Flag Captured
findings.description: The /jobs POST endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection. An allowlist filter blocks common SQL keywords like 'OR', 'UNION', 'SELECT', but can be bypassed using double-letter obfuscation (e.g., 'oorr' instead of 'or'). The injection allows bypassing the job_type filter to retrieve all records including private/admin-only jobs.

reproduction.expected: Returns all jobs including private ones with the flag in the description field
